title: Drill: looking up data and calculating 1 - 123 school
heading: Drill: looking up data and calculating 1
intro: Each question tells you which BINAS table you need. Use a calculator where needed.

questions.question: In which BINAS table do you find the molar mass of commonly used substances?
In which BINAS table do you find the relative atomic mass of an element?
In which BINAS table do you find the density of liquids such as ethanol and benzene?
In which BINAS table do you find the density of metals such as copper and iron?
In which BINAS table do you find Avogadro's constant and the molar volume?
In which BINAS table do you find the formulas for concentration and density?
In which BINAS table do you find whether a salt dissolves well or poorly in water?
What is the molar mass of CaCO<sub>3</sub>? (BINAS table 98)
What is the molar mass of NaCl? (BINAS table 98)
What is the molar mass of H<sub>2</sub>SO<sub>4</sub>? (BINAS table 98)
What is the molar mass of glucose, C<sub>6</sub>H<sub>12</sub>O<sub>6</sub>? (BINAS table 98)
What is the relative atomic mass of iron? (BINAS table 99)
Calculate the molar mass of Mg(OH)<sub>2</sub> using the atomic masses from BINAS table 99 (Mg 24.31, O 16.00, H 1.008)
How many moles is 29.2 g of NaCl? (M from BINAS table 98)
How many grams do you weigh for 0.250 mol of NaOH? (M from BINAS table 98)
How many moles of CO<sub>2</sub> is 22.0 g? (M from BINAS table 98)
How many grams is 0.0500 mol of H<sub>2</sub>SO<sub>4</sub>? (M from BINAS table 98)
How many mmol of glucose are in 5.00 g of glucose? (M from BINAS table 98)
What is the density of ethanol in g/mL? (BINAS table 11)
Calculate the mass of 50 mL of ethanol. Use the density from BINAS table 11
Calculate the mass of 20.0 mL of mercury. Use the density from BINAS table 11
Calculate the volume of 100 g of copper. Use the density from BINAS table 8
An aluminium block measures 5.0 cm × 4.0 cm × 2.0 cm. Calculate the mass using the density from BINAS table 8
You need 63 g of benzene. How many mL is that? Use the density from BINAS table 11
Which substance has the greatest density: aluminium, copper or lead? (BINAS table 8)

answers.b: they all have the same density

questions.question: You dissolve 0.50 mol of NaCl to make 250 mL of solution. What is the concentration?
How many grams of NaOH do you need for 500 mL of a 0.10 mol/L solution? (M from BINAS table 98)
You dissolve 5.85 g of NaCl to make 500 mL of solution. What is the concentration? (M from BINAS table 98)
How many mL of a 0.50 mol/L HCl solution contain 0.010 mol of HCl?
You dilute 20 mL of a 1.0 mol/L solution with water to 100 mL. What is the new concentration?
A solution of CaCl<sub>2</sub> has a concentration of 0.10 mol/L. What is [Cl<sup>–</sup>]?
A solution of Na<sub>2</sub>SO<sub>4</sub> has a concentration of 0.10 mol/L. What is [Na<sup>+</sup>]?
A solution of Al(NO<sub>3</sub>)<sub>3</sub> has a concentration of 0.20 mol/L. What is [NO<sub>3</sub><sup>–</sup>]?
Which ions are formed when you dissolve Na<sub>2</sub>CO<sub>3</sub> in water?
How many molecules are in 0.50 mol of water? (Avogadro's constant from BINAS table 7A)
What is the volume of 2.00 mol of gas at 298 K and p<sub>0</sub>? (molar volume from BINAS table 7A: 24.5 dm<sup>3</sup>/mol)
Is AgCl very soluble or poorly soluble in water? (BINAS table 45A)
Is NaNO<sub>3</sub> very soluble or poorly soluble in water? (BINAS table 45A)
Is BaSO<sub>4</sub> very soluble or poorly soluble in water? (BINAS table 45A)
Is CaCO<sub>3</sub> very soluble or poorly soluble in water? (BINAS table 45A)
What does 'g' mean in BINAS table 45A?

answers.a: very soluble: more than about 0.1 mol/L
answers.d: poorly soluble: less than about 0.01 mol/L

questions.question: You mix solutions of sodium chloride and silver nitrate. What happens according to BINAS table 45A?

answers.a: A precipitate of silver chloride forms
answers.b: A precipitate of sodium chloride forms
answers.d: A precipitate of sodium nitrate forms
